description.text:
We are seeking an experienced Linux/Kernel Software Engineer to collaborate closely with our internal development teams and US-based clients. In this role, you will:
- Work with Global Talents: Collaborate directly with cross-country elite software engineers in a highly professional environment.
- Drive Chromebook Performance: Join the Chromebook team to enhance product performance, reliability, and system stability.
- System Triage & Troubleshooting: Take charge of issue triage, diagnostics, and root-cause analysis for complex system issues.
- Bug Fixing & Module Improvement: Develop solutions and perform bug-fixing for various software modules.
Key Qualifications:
- Bachelor’s degree or above in Computer Science, Computer/Electrical Engineering or equivalent.
- 2+ years’ working experience on software development or debugging.
- Must have good knowledge on Linux kernel or driver.
- Great capability on system troubleshooting.
- Fluency in C/C++ programming.
- English proficiency in reading, writing, and listening, good in speaking is a plus.
